sources.title: Core skill service
sources.supports: Skill root resolution, snapshot construction, configuration/cwd caches, filtering, and cache invalidation API.
sources.limitations: Does not execute a skill script or establish the policy for every downstream tool family.

evidence_points.point: skill_roots_for_config derives roots from config, cwd, plugins, and extra roots before loading.
snapshot_for_config and snapshot_for_cwd return HostSkillsSnapshot values and use separate cache maps.
clear_cache clears cwd and config snapshots.

sources.title: Skill discovery and frontmatter loader
sources.supports: Root scanning, SKILL.md metadata parsing, validation limits, and SkillError production.
sources.limitations: Metadata discovery does not itself inject the body or authorize a process.

evidence_points.point: load_skills_from_roots delegates to root loading; parser structures require frontmatter name/description and enforce size limits.

sources.title: Explicit skill mention and body injection
sources.supports: Structured/text mention selection, provider-authorized body reads, warnings, and explicit invocation analytics.
sources.limitations: The module does not decide shell approval or execute arbitrary skill scripts.

evidence_points.point: collect_explicit_skill_mentions resolves structured UserInput::Skill by enabled path.
Text inputs are scanned for tool mentions and selected only when path/name rules succeed.
build_skill_injections reads through a filesystem authority and turns errors into warnings.
Explicit injection increments codex.skill.injected and sends SkillInvocation analytics.

sources.title: Implicit skill invocation detection
sources.supports: Recognition of supported script runners/extensions and matching SKILL.md reads.
sources.limitations: This detector attributes a command; it does not spawn the command.

evidence_points.point: The detector checks python/python3/bash/zsh/sh/node/deno/ruby/perl/pwsh and script extensions, then checks parsed SKILL.md reads.

sources.title: Available skill metadata renderer
sources.supports: Model-visible skill metadata rendering, context budgets, truncation, omission, and warnings.
sources.limitations: A rendered catalog does not prove a skill body was read or selected.

evidence_points.point: build_available_skills selects allowed skills, applies budget, and reports omitted/truncated descriptions.
Renderer creates warnings when descriptions or entries exceed the configured budget.

sources.title: Core skill invocation bridge
sources.supports: Per-turn deduplication, implicit contributor callbacks, metrics, and analytics tracking.
sources.limitations: Analytics are observability records and do not constitute a durable execution trace.

evidence_points.point: Implicit invocation uses a scope/path/name seen key, notifies contributors, increments a metric, and tracks InvocationType::Implicit.

sources.title: Session context and turn integration
sources.supports: When skill instructions are included, the session adds available-skill context and extension contributions to turn context.
sources.limitations: The full turn path contains many feature/task branches not represented by one excerpt.

evidence_points.point: Session renders available skills when include_skill_instructions is enabled and appends extension context fragments.

sources.title: Skills extension lifecycle and contributors
sources.supports: Extension catalog/context integration, skill tool registration, turn-local state, body reads, and implicit invocation callbacks.
sources.limitations: Provider-specific behavior is delegated to provider implementations.

evidence_points.point: Extension lists source-aware catalogs for context contributors.
Turn contributor reads selected main prompts and stores SkillsTurnState.
tools returns the namespaced skill list/read executors when orchestrator skills are enabled.

sources.title: Skill provider authority interface
sources.supports: Provider-owned list/read/search operations and authority-preserving resource access.
sources.limitations: The trait contract does not by itself prove every provider enforces identical limits.

evidence_points.point: SkillProvider exposes list/read/search and requires resources to remain within their authority.
Provider boundary is explicit in SkillReadRequest and provider-owned resource routing.

sources.title: Model-facing skills.list/read tools
sources.supports: Namespaced model tools, opaque bounded handles, authority rechecks, provider reads, and structured outputs.
sources.limitations: Current implementation supports the orchestrator authority for these tools; other sources use extension context paths.

evidence_points.point: ListTool returns bounded package/name/description/main-resource handles.
ReadTool validates handles, checks enabled authority/package, reads provider resource, and returns external JSON.

sources.title: App-server skill watcher and catalog API
sources.supports: Client-facing skill list/config calls and change-driven cache invalidation.
sources.limitations: Exact wire fields belong to the versioned app-server protocol types.

evidence_points.point: Watcher event loop clears SkillsService cache on skill changes.
Catalog processor implements skills/list and skills/config/write request paths.

sources.title: TUI skill commands and client requests
sources.supports: TUI entry points for browsing and configuring skills.
sources.limitations: The TUI is a client surface; it does not replace core/provider authority checks.

evidence_points.point: TUI exposes /skills and calls the app-server skills/list path.

sources.title: Unified execution runtime
sources.supports: Local command approval, sandbox permissions, process execution, cancellation, and output path for CLI/script commands.
sources.limitations: The detector does not select or enforce every arbitrary command a skill might recommend.

evidence_points.point: UnifiedExecRuntime owns approval/sandbox traits and process execution.
The runtime exposes sandbox permissions and approval keys before execution.

sources.title: Skill loading, selection, injection, and authority tests
sources.supports: Reproducible examples for skill selection, approval, injection, and authority-preserving reads.
sources.limitations: Tests cover selected scenarios, not every possible host command or provider.

evidence_points.point: Skill tests exercise approval and authority-specific filesystem reads.
Extension tests cover selected skill list/body injection and failure behavior.
